verdict.rationale: Asaas documents online credit and debit card payments through its API, card processing at payment creation, payment links, and an Asaas-hosted checkout page. These are the core pieces needed to accept a card payment online, and a sandbox supports early testing. Nothing in the pack covers how quickly a new account is approved or allowed to process live card payments, so the 'within a day of signing up' part is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-live onboarding time or KYC/approval speed, independent or hands-on confirmation of a fast first live card payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: With the Asaas API, you can automate charges, receipts, and payments via Pix, bank slip (boleto), credit card, debit card, and TED.
